title: Section 760.3 – Revise Section 760.3(F) to read as follows:
officialText:
(F) Optical Fiber Cables. Where optical fiber cables are utilized for fire alarm circuits, the cables shall be supervised
and installed in EMT, IMC or RMC and terminated in equipment listed for fire alarm use. Where installed underground
between buildings, optical fiber cables shall be permitted to be installed in non-metallic conduit buried or concrete
encased.
